Hey Chris and Tyler,

STA Support Chat is officially live for the support team. This is the first of the team-facing AI tools rolling out as part of Phase 1, and it's purpose-built for what you two do every day - product troubleshooting and customer communications.

**What it is.** A shared Claude.ai Project that's been loaded with the STA Help Center across every product line we support (TT3/TT7/TT10, SchoolTRAK, Tardy Kiosk, Food Service, Visitor Management, ID Badging, Positive Attendance, Transcript Labels, ID Printers) plus Skyward compatibility, product mechanics, and our routing conventions. 16 context files in total. The job is to cut the time from "customer reports an issue" to "I know what to ask them next" to "I've drafted a reply."

**The one hard rule built into it.** NEVER FABRICATE. If it doesn't have grounding for an answer, it tells you so explicitly instead of guessing. Every substantive answer comes with a source label (Context-confirmed / Training knowledge / Training knowledge - verify carefully / Cannot confirm without live access) so you know what you're working with before you act on it. This is the rule that makes drafts safe to send after review.

**What you should do this week.**

1. Read the AI Acceptable Use Policy and Restricted Data Reference Guide (both attached, both required before first use). Confirm back to me when done.
2. Read the Getting Started Guide for the AI program overall (attached).
3. Read the STA Support Chat - Getting Started one-pager (attached) - this is the tool-specific brief. About 5 minutes.
4. Open claude.ai with your @k12sta.com email, find "STA Support Chat" in your Projects list, and try it on a real ticket you have open right now. Don't make up a test scenario - real ones give you a real feel for the tool. The one-pager has five suggested first prompts.

**How to access.** claude.ai &rarr; sign in with your work email &rarr; Projects in the left sidebar &rarr; STA Support Chat. If you see "Personal" in the top of the sidebar, you're in the wrong account - log out and back in with your work email directly. No setup needed; the project is shared with you automatically.

**If something is off.** Tell me. Wrong answers, weird tone, missed context - all of that is useful feedback. The tool's instructions can be updated, and the more sharply it works for you, the more it helps. If you have Cowork access (Tyler, not yet; Chris, when you want it) you can use the Agent Quality Logger; otherwise just email me what happened.

**What's next.** AI Advisor is also live for both of you - that's the explore-and-ask-questions tool, not the do-the-work tool. STA Main Chat (general org / product lookups) is in the build pipeline. Once you're settled in with Support Chat, I'll loop you in on what's next.

Quick 30-min walkthrough if either of you want one - just reply with a time. Otherwise, the docs are enough to get going.

Thanks,
Adam
